messages:
lee: Heads-up — after the 07:00 UTC driver push to ap-southeast-2, ~12 nodes are dropping to emergency.target during boot. Appears dkms/module verification rejects the nvidia module.
jamie: ugh. Which driver version rolled?
lee: We pushed 570.12 -> nodes were on 555.X before. Secure boot is enabled on those hosts (customer requirement).
anika: Can you paste the dmesg/journal snippet?
lee: sure, from one affected host — this is the key bit:
```
[    3.214567] nvidia: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel.
[    3.214580] nvidia: module verification failed: signature and required key missing - tainting kernel
[    3.214592] nvidia: disagrees about version of symbol module_layout
[    3.214600] DKMS: build error for module nvidia-570.12 on kernel 6.1.21
[    3.214612] dracut-initqueue timeout, starting emergency shell
```
sam: shows as DKMS build error + modsig issue. we probably didn't sign the new .ko with the MOK key.
jeff-deploy-bot: Rolling back 8/12 effected nodes to previous driver image (555.x) — canaries passed on 4 nodes earlier, now rollback in progress :recycle:
jamie: Are these nodes using the private pkcs11 key or our central HSM?
lee: They are on HSM-backed key via kms-agent on the host. The signing step in the new package didn't pick up the MOK.
anika: If MOK signing failed, modprobe will refuse if secureboot=enabled. Can we re-run the signing step remotely? Might need to enroll new key if packaging changed.
sam: short term: cordon affected nodes and drain. I'll mark capacity in ap-southeast-2 degraded and kick up spare pool in us-west-1.
ops-bot: @channel Incident created: INC-2026-1986 - DKMS/module-signature failures in ap-southeast-2 (12 nodes). Priority: P2.
lee: Steps I ran: 1) inspected /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/570.12/build/make.log — shows unsigned module 2) checked /etc/modprobe.d/secureboot.conf — secureboot=1 3) attempted manual sign with /usr/src/mok/sign_and_enroll.sh -> got "no MOK found"
jamie: Sounds like packager forgot to include the MOK cert. Do we have a CI signing job that uses `mokutil` to enroll?
anika: Our package pipeline used to sign modules inside image build. New package path switched to post-install dkms hook which runs as root on host — but the hook expects /etc/mok/keys/mok.pem. Looks like the file isn't present on some hosts (config drift).
sam: config drift again. How many nodes missing the file?
lee: quick grep across fleet shows ~18 hosts missing /etc/mok/keys/mok.pem; 12 of those are in ap-southeast-2 and were in the rollout batch.
jamie: Action items: 1) stop rollout 2) rollback remaining hosts 3) patch packager to sign earlier or include fallback that uses HSM via kms-agent 4) add preflight check for /etc/mok/keys/mok.pem 5) remediate missing certs via automation.
anika: I'll own patching the packager (CI) — will add a unit that errors the build if MOK not baked.
sam: I'll run automation to push the missing pem to the 18 hosts and then try a targeted rebuild on one repro host (non-critical) to validate.
lee: For immediate mitigation — I'm running a script to auto-enroll the cert on the affected nodes (using existing MOK in our secure bucket). Running stealth enroll so we avoid manual reboots where possible.
jamie: FYI enrolling MOK requires reboot for kernel to accept module? We need to coordinate reboots with workloads.
lee: yes reboot required where MOK was just enrolled. I'm staggering reboots and signalling jobs to reschedule.
ops-bot: Rollback progress: 8/12 completed, 4 pending (one in a stuck state)
sam: Cost note — moving capacity between regions temporarily will spin up extra reserved GPUs in us-west-1; estimated extra spend ~ $3k/day until ap-southeast pool healthy. Flagging finance.
lee: I've updated the internal runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dkms-mok-signing|runbook> with steps and logs.
anika: After packager fix I'll cut a rebuild and run a small canary (2 nodes) with secureboot on. If green, resume rollout with 5-node batches and 30m watch.
jamie: Good. Also add a preflight that runs `modinfo -F filename nvidia` to ensure module is signed on image before rollout.
lee: I'll keep this thread updated as rollbacks finish. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1986 status changed to "mitigating"
